definitions: Used to express a conditional or hypothetical situation.
Used to express a past habit or repeated action.
Used to express a polite request or offer.
Used to express a wish or desire.
Used as the past tense of 'will' in reported speech.
examples: If I had time, I would visit.
Every summer, we would go to the beach.
Would you mind opening the window?
I would love to travel the world.
She said she would be late.
